verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API, but its stated scope is narrow: automating deployment, audit logs, and reporting. Nothing shows the API matches the UI's functions, such as starting or sharing sessions, guest app permissions, or admin-panel provisioning, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for session/connection control, sharing, guest access and settings management; a published API reference/OpenAPI spec; any statement or corroboration of UI–API parity; availability outside Teams/Enterprise plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
